title: A Will for the Parish
author: Jude Dunmore
blurb: August Brightwater, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
